embeds.title: 💀 BREAKING: SKELETONS GO ON STRIKE — KING REFUSES TO STOP SWINGING
embeds.description:
*Satirical dispatch from the Ashen Kingdom.*

Trouble is brewing in the burning colosseum — and for once, it isn't just the lava.

After another round of sword strikes, whirlwind attacks and airborne skeletons, the undead workforce has filed an official complaint against His Majesty.

🦴 **Their demands:** shorter battles, longer breaks, and at least one day off before being smashed to pieces again.

“We don't even have muscles,” said a skeleton spokesperson, “yet somehow we're exhausted.”

👑 **The King's response?** He declined to comment. Witnesses say he responded with a spectacular spinning attack instead.

Negotiations collapsed. So did the negotiating committee.

🔥 **King of Ash** is live on Playgama. How many waves can YOU survive before the skeletons demand another break?
